blind.description: An antique metallic candle stand consisting of a circular tiered pedestal base, a slender turned baluster stem with a rounded collar, and an upward-curving crescent moon bracket cradling a thick cream-colored wax candle with a black wick. The metallic surfaces have a polished, slightly aged pewter or brass sheen. All components are solid, smooth, and fully connected with no flame or glowing effects.
blind.from_above: A circular stepped metal base rim framing an elongated, pointed crescent moon shape that encloses a circular off-white candle top with a centered black wick dot.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the figure (around 2 feet / 60 cm tall) and slightly narrower than the figure's diameter.
